title: Nov. 4 PCSO lotto results: P333.42M jackpot not won

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the P333.42 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the P15 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026. According to the PCSO results provided, the Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 17-22-04-54-01-41, which carried a jackpot prize of P333.42 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 draw yielded the winning combination 04-43-19-38-06-31 for a P15 million jackpot. No bettor won the top prize.
